hyperedges.label: Learning session lifecycle (plan, run tasks, commit, summary)
Learner content isolation (overrides, owned meanings, admin approval)

nodes.label: LP reconcile (read-only)
nodes.rationale: Correction is a separate audited process; auto-rewrite could hide a bug

nodes.label: Azure speech track (EWMA, hysteresis)
nodes.rationale: Hysteresis stops a word flipping on every 79/81

nodes.label: Skill system removed
nodes.rationale: Spelling/listening duplicated FSRS or mixed hearing with memory

nodes.label: Custom word override (PUT/DELETE .../override)
nodes.rationale: Field-level merge so editing meaning does not lose edited examples

nodes.label: Custom words (user-added words)
nodes.rationale: User edits only affect that user; context-generated meanings private until admin approval

nodes.label: Challenge Map (Match Madness)
nodes.rationale: Separate from Daily; never blocks new words, never changes SRS or speaking progress

nodes.label: Result reducer (task -> target -> MemoryObservation + SkillEvidence)
nodes.rationale: At most one MemoryObservation per Meaning per session; recall outranks recognition.

nodes.label: learning_sessions table (plan, raw_events, result)
nodes.rationale: Issued != committed; plan immutable, only retention may NULL it; result kept long-term.

nodes.label: speech_assessment_receipts table
nodes.rationale: Temporary technical staging; no learning evidence before Finish.

nodes.label: fly_reorder template
nodes.rationale: Backend replays tap/remove/move ops; submit tileIds must match replayed state

nodes.label: Task event rules (seq, retries, hint, reveal)
nodes.norm_label: task event rules (seq, retries, hint, reveal)

nodes.label: Challenge board rules (SHA256 column order, refill)
nodes.norm_label: challenge board rules (sha256 column order, refill)
nodes.rationale: Client must mirror server rules exactly; server re-validates events

nodes.label: Client instant evaluation, server re-grades from events
nodes.norm_label: client instant evaluation, server re-grades from events
nodes.rationale: Client gives instant feedback but backend re-scores all events at commit; client never sends correct/incorrect

nodes.label: Recognition Grace
nodes.rationale: Recognition-only reviews cannot postpone due forever; grace used once.

nodes.label: Mode-specific SRS policy (superseded by FSRS-6)
nodes.rationale: Non-daily success does not extend SRS to prevent success farming.

nodes.label: Trust boundary: client holds answer key
nodes.norm_label: trust boundary: client holds answer key
nodes.rationale: Replay improves consistency but cannot prove honesty; high-stakes would need a different architecture.

nodes.label: Custom word appendix
nodes.rationale: Learner content stays private; AI meanings shared only after admin approval of stored AI text.

nodes.label: dailySpeaking setting
nodes.rationale: Speaking correctness never affects word progress (SRS, result groups, LP); only pronunciation practice

nodes.label: 'I know this word' known check
nodes.rationale: Known words first review after 7 days; a failed check is not counted as forgetting

nodes.label: New word ordering (intro batches, 5 practice rounds)
nodes.norm_label: new word ordering (intro batches, 5 practice rounds)
nodes.rationale: flyReorder only for words <= 8 graphemes since tiles get too small

nodes.label: Drizzle drops undefined in and()/where(undefined)
nodes.rationale: Widens update/delete to every row; never pass optional id

nodes.label: Raw db.execute returns timestamptz as text (toDate)
nodes.norm_label: raw db.execute returns timestamptz as text (todate)

nodes.label: Pure logic free of Nest and Drizzle
nodes.community_name: Singleton: Pure logic free of Nest and Drizzle
nodes.norm_label: pure logic free of nest and drizzle

nodes.label: Run seeds through Nest build
nodes.community_name: Singleton: Run seeds through Nest build
nodes.rationale: tsx/esbuild does not emit decorator metadata

nodes.label: Index policy (B-tree first, GIN only if needed)
nodes.community_name: Singleton: Index policy (B-tree first, GIN only if
nodes.norm_label: index policy (b-tree first, gin only if needed)

nodes.label: Repeated Meaning on the board rule
nodes.norm_label: repeated meaning on the board rule
nodes.rationale: Player picks pairs, so queue order alone cannot guarantee spacing

nodes.label: Daily review (one meaning task per due word)
nodes.norm_label: daily review (one meaning task per due word)

nodes.label: Daily speaking (opt-in)
nodes.rationale: Recording shows the word so it is no retrieval and carries no memory evidence

nodes.label: Evidence classes (weighted evidence)
nodes.rationale: Most templates are recognition; ignoring them left words due forever

nodes.label: FSRS-6 scheduler
nodes.rationale: FSRS ships parameters trained on large review logs and needs no data to start

nodes.label: Placement test
nodes.rationale: Server-graded; option id is wordId so no stored answer needed

nodes.label: Priming
nodes.rationale: Recall primed when answer appears in the immediately preceding step; counts as assisted

nodes.label: Speaking never feeds FSRS
nodes.rationale: A miss cannot tell forgetting from weak pronunciation or ASR error

nodes.label: Dual-target mapping (Meaning + Pronunciation)
nodes.rationale: select(audio) may yield Meaning memory and Listening evidence; both IDs must belong to the same Word/Type.

nodes.label: Localization pipeline (template copy + published vocab locale + curated item locale)
nodes.norm_label: localization pipeline (template copy + published vocab locale + curated item locale)

nodes.label: Practice Resolver (resolve task)
nodes.rationale: Fails closed: no runtime machine translation, no fake audio URLs.

nodes.label: app_user.proficiency_level
nodes.rationale: Only one column, no placement tables; orders new Meanings by CEFR and gates contextual items.

nodes.label: Publication rules (Meaning x locale immutable snapshot)
nodes.norm_label: publication rules (meaning x locale immutable snapshot)

nodes.label: meaning_publications / active_meaning_publications tables
nodes.rationale: Runtime resolves only from published snapshots, never mutable drafts.

nodes.label: practice_items (+ localizations, targets) tables
nodes.rationale: One table for curated items of every template; each row is an immutable content revision via supersedes_item_id.

nodes.label: Contextual gating (context_cefr_level <= proficiency_level)
nodes.rationale: Avoid puzzling beginners with contextual questions above their level.

nodes.label: Generated + Curated practice content
nodes.rationale: No N x 7 rows on import; Generated tasks persisted only as session snapshots.

nodes.label: Retired templates audioSelect / split / trace
nodes.rationale: Banned in v0.4 issuance; legacy snapshots need a versioned reader.

nodes.label: New Meaning Learning Cycle (select + typing|flyReorder + recording)
nodes.norm_label: new meaning learning cycle (select + typing|flyreorder + recording)

nodes.label: clozeSelect template
nodes.rationale: Choose one option for a single blank; not full-sentence tile reordering.

nodes.label: flyReorder template
nodes.rationale: Grapheme tiles with stable integer IDs; server replays ordered tileIds rather than trusting the rendered string.

nodes.label: select template
nodes.rationale: Single correctOptionId evaluator shared by gloss, phoneticChoice, stressChoice variants.

nodes.label: typing.transcription variant (replaces audio trace)
nodes.rationale: Transcription of heard English is not semantic recall.

nodes.label: Client contract: minimal but complete task payload
nodes.norm_label: client contract: minimal but complete task payload
nodes.rationale: Task never exposes wordId/meaningId/targets; client grades locally without querying Meaning.

nodes.label: Interleaving of practice across Meanings
nodes.rationale: Avoid the answer appearing right before Meaning-cued recall (priming).

nodes.label: prompt.type is not a skill mapping
nodes.norm_label: prompt.type is not a skill mapping
nodes.rationale: Skill is derived from assessment intent + target + reply type + delivered mode + hints, not prompt modality alone.

nodes.label: Universal prompt envelope (text | audio)
nodes.rationale: Template defines interaction; prompt.type only defines stimulus modality; exactly one primary prompt mode per task.

nodes.label: Atomic commit algorithm
nodes.rationale: Single transaction, per-user lock, server replay; never call Azure inside the transaction.

nodes.label: Collection -> Topic -> Word -> Type -> Meaning hierarchy
nodes.norm_label: collection -> topic -> word -> type -> meaning hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Progress is unique per (user, meaning) even when a Meaning appears in several Topics.

nodes.label: Daily Session (Review Due -> Learn New -> Active Recall -> Finish)
nodes.norm_label: daily session (review due -> learn new -> active recall -> finish)

nodes.label: Per-user commit serialization (row lock / advisory lock)
nodes.norm_label: per-user commit serialization (row lock / advisory lock)

nodes.label: Vocab Flow MVP System Design Blueprint v1.1
nodes.norm_label: vocab flow mvp system design blueprint v1.1

nodes.label: Vocab Flow MVP System Design Master Spec
nodes.norm_label: vocab flow mvp system design master spec

nodes.label: Vocab Flow Backend FULL SPEC v0.4
nodes.norm_label: vocab flow backend full spec v0.4

nodes.label: All-or-nothing session semantics
nodes.rationale: Abandon before Finish never updates learning; only a successful backend commit sets learnedAt, review progress and evidence.

nodes.label: Idempotency via sessionId + SHA-256 canonical request
nodes.norm_label: idempotency via sessionid + sha-256 canonical request

nodes.label: Account deletion (DELETE /v1/me)
nodes.rationale: All-or-nothing; shared content kept but unlinked from user

nodes.label: Auth API (/v1/auth/*, Supabase proxy)
nodes.rationale: Backend proxies Supabase Auth; 403 WRONG_PASSWORD instead of 401 so client does not log out

nodes.label: Placement test (/v1/me/placement-test)
nodes.rationale: Level passes at 60%; result is highest level where it and all lower levels pass; 'Don't know' avoids inflated level

nodes.label: Weekly ranking / leaderboard
nodes.rationale: Opt-in; resets Monday 00:00 UTC; position shown as rank/percentile/unranked to avoid shaming

nodes.label: Tier (lifetime achievement)
nodes.rationale: Tier never decreases; tier_lifetime_lp_v2 counts only lifetime LP

nodes.label: Session result statistics summary
nodes.rationale: Groups derived server-side from the commit's SRS/speaking decisions; client never recomputes

nodes.label: Tests against embedded real Postgres
nodes.rationale: No Docker needed; real Postgres catches SQL-level behavior

nodes.label: Hand-written SQL migrations (CHECK, partial indexes, triggers, FKs)
nodes.norm_label: hand-written sql migrations (check, partial indexes, triggers, fks)
nodes.rationale: Not expressible in src/db/schema.ts; test/schema.test.ts diffs catalog against spec/*.sql

nodes.label: DB session TimeZone must be UTC
nodes.norm_label: db session timezone must be utc

nodes.label: Never select plan, raw_events, result unless used
nodes.norm_label: never select plan, raw_events, result unless used

nodes.label: No extra round trips, no N+1
nodes.norm_label: no extra round trips, no n+1
nodes.rationale: A request's query count must not grow with data; read once with inArray + Map, write with one multi-row insert

nodes.label: RLS on every table with no policies
nodes.norm_label: rls on every table with no policies
nodes.rationale: anon/authenticated cannot reach tables via PostgREST; app uses postgres role which bypasses RLS

nodes.label: Caddy route routes/vocab.caddy (handle_path /service/vocab)
nodes.rationale: Caddy belongs to money-space; handle_path strips prefix so app still serves /v1, /health, /docs at root

nodes.label: Deploy pipeline: push to master -> arm64 image -> OCIR -> ssh
nodes.norm_label: deploy pipeline: push to master -> arm64 image -> ocir -> ssh

nodes.label: Rollback via BACKEND_IMAGE
nodes.rationale: Migrations are not reversed

nodes.label: App port published on 127.0.0.1 only
nodes.rationale: Public path goes through Caddy

nodes.label: Azure Pronunciation Assessment adapter
nodes.rationale: Invalid/unavailable audio is not a Speaking failure; AccuracyScore >= 80 trial threshold.

nodes.label: Checkpoint Challenge (every 7 new-learning sessions)
nodes.rationale: Counted per session, not per calendar day; created inside commit transaction.

nodes.label: Commit body (raw events only, deliveryMode)
nodes.rationale: Client never asserts correct/skill/meaningId; backend replays events against immutable snapshot.

nodes.label: App-generated UUID v7 ids (newId)
nodes.rationale: DB columns have no default; call newId() when an id is needed before insert

nodes.label: Constants for repeated values
nodes.rationale: Domain enums, error codes, event names in src/common/constants; trial numbers in src/config/policy.ts

nodes.label: Domain consts naming (UPPER_SNAKE keys, lower_snake values)
nodes.norm_label: domain consts naming (upper_snake keys, lower_snake values)

nodes.label: scopeEvents computed inside writeCommit
nodes.rationale: Computed from pre-write snapshot and stored in commit_response so a retry replays the first answer

nodes.label: words unique on language + lower(btrim(lemma)) + homograph_key
nodes.norm_label: words unique on language + lower(btrim(lemma)) + homograph_key
nodes.rationale: Search the key before inserting; pool writes take content from lexical_drafts, never the request

nodes.label: Custom words: translation
nodes.rationale: Sessions never call AI since text is stored in the snapshot

nodes.label: Learner pool isolation (non-negotiable)
nodes.rationale: What a learner writes never changes shared content; edits in user_meaning_overrides, owned meanings via owner_user_id, shared only by admin approval of stored AI text

nodes.label: Custom words: approval
nodes.rationale: A learner's edit never affects the shared pool; AI draft published unedited; owned meanings shared only after admin approves stored AI text

nodes.label: ElevenLabs TTS from IPA
nodes.rationale: Voiced from IPA not spelling; URL never reveals the word

nodes.label: Pronunciations per Meaning
nodes.rationale: Senses of one spelling can sound different (read /ri:d/, /red/)

nodes.label: Spec case IDs C01-C62 in tests
nodes.norm_label: spec case ids c01-c62 in tests

nodes.label: Stale publication refresh
nodes.rationale: Publications are immutable, so new audio needs a new revision copying the live snapshot

nodes.label: Review scope R/C/B (review-scope.sql.ts)
nodes.rationale: Planner, learn-home, commit, journey and challenge map must share them or Home and the plan disagree

nodes.label: reviewableSql (all learned Meanings minus paused collections)
nodes.norm_label: reviewablesql (all learned meanings minus paused collections)

nodes.label: Known check (D)
nodes.rationale: Product experiment for learners who already know English

nodes.label: Review source D2 (all learned minus paused)
nodes.norm_label: review source d2 (all learned minus paused)

nodes.label: Late recall credit (A)
nodes.rationale: Recall after a longer gap shows it holds that long, so a backlog spreads itself out
